stRequested_Chef_Body: Your card is on hold for {amount}. {kitchen} answers by {deadline}.
stApproved_Chef_Body: {unit} at {kitchen}. Starts {start}. Your card was charged {amount}.
stDeclined_Chef_Body: Your card hold was released. Nothing was charged.
stExpired_Chef_Body: {kitchen} didn’t answer in time. Your card hold was released.
stExpired_Kitchen_Body: {chef}’s request for {listing} expired. The card hold was released.
stMoveInDue_Chef_Body: Your storage starts {start}. Add move-in photos to record the unit’s condition.
stMovedIn_Kitchen_Body: {chef} moved into {listing} · {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} added.
stEnding_Chef_Body: {days, plural, =0 {Extend now} one {Extend 1 day} other {Extend # days}} · {amount}.
stEnding_Kitchen_Body: {chef}’s storage is paid through {paidThrough}. They can extend until then.
stExtended_Chef_Body: You paid {amount}. Your storage runs to {paidThrough}.
stGraceStarted_Chef_Body: Your paid days ended. Extend by {graceEndsOn} at the same price.
stGraceStarted_Kitchen_Body: {chef} can extend {listing} at the same price until {graceEndsOn}.
stHoldoverStarted_Chef_Title: Your storage is past its paid time
stHoldoverStarted_Chef_Body: {daily} per day may be charged by {kitchen}.
stHoldoverStarted_Kitchen_Body: {chef}’s storage is past {paidThrough}. Raise a charge or waive it.
stHoldoverCharge_Chef_Body: Pay {amount} for {days, plural, one {1 day} other {# days}}, or dispute by {deadline}.
stReclaim_Chef_Body: {kitchen} asks you to move out by {byDate}. You’ll be refunded {amount}.
stReclaim_Kitchen_Body: {chef} must move out by {byDate}. Unused days ({amount}) are refunded.
stMoveOutRequested_Chef_Body: {kitchen} will inspect {listing} and confirm you’ve cleared it.
stMoveOutRequested_Kitchen_Body: {chef} asked to move out of {listing}. Inspect the unit and confirm clearance.
stCleared_Chef_Body: {kitchen} confirmed you cleared {listing}. Holdover charges stop at {date}.
stReopened_Chef_Body: {kitchen} found items in {listing}. Your storage is active again from {date}.
stReopened_Kitchen_Body: {chef}’s storage is active again from {date}. Holdover resumes from the original date.
stRemovalReview_Chef_Body: {kitchen} opened a removal review for {listing}. Move out or extend to keep your items.
stRemovalReview_Kitchen_Body: {chef}’s storage is in removal review. You may act after the final-notice deadlines.
stFinalNotice_Chef_Body: Local Cooks sent a final notice. Perishables may be removed after {perishableDate}; other items after {otherDate}. {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} on file.
stFinalNotice_Kitchen_Body: You may act after {perishableDate} for perishables and {otherDate} for other items.
stRefundIssued_Chef_Body: Your refund of {amount} is on its way. Banks usually show it within 5–10 business days.
stRefundIssued_Kitchen_Body: {chef}’s refund of {amount} comes out of your payout for {listing}.
stPayoutScheduled_Kitchen_Body: You’ll be paid {amount} on {payoutDate} for {chef}’s storage {start}–{end}.
stPayoutReleased_Kitchen_Body: You’ve been paid {amount} for {chef}’s storage {start}–{end}. It’s on its way to your bank.
stPayoutOnHold_Kitchen_Body: {amount} for {chef}’s storage is on hold while Local Cooks reviews an open issue.
stKitchenDebt_Kitchen_Body: {amount} couldn’t be taken back from your Stripe balance. You owe Local Cooks {amount}.
stOfferExtension_Chef_Body: {kitchen} offers {days, plural, one {1 more day} other {# more days}} for {amount}. Extend to keep your items.
